snippet.title: MyNSMBWii Traditional Mod - Reveal Trailer [Modding Direct 2025]
snippet.description:
Hi! This is the Reveal Trailer of my Mod! First Footage shown. 

This was the Trailer made for the Modding Direct of 2025



What is this Mod About?


MyNSMBWii Traditional Mod is a Mod inspired of Nintendo levels style. I Started this mod at 29th Of July 2024. I pretend making levels that when the player plays them, make the player feels like it was Nintendo making them, but generally with different gameplay.

I really enjoy the Vanilla Game Vibes/Style, so i want to revive the childhood nostalgia that many have when they played these game for the first times, whether alone or with friends, but with different levels, and different experiences!



Link of the Part where my Trailer shows up in the Modding Direct:

https://youtu.be/fhjTXwBap6Q?t=6520&si=ITIK3d0xXiR_bcQY
